duration.details: Until you cast this again or take a Safe Rest

description.baseEffect:
Cantrip · 1 Action · Shepherd Only. Blue’s Codex version of the Nimble 0.2 Lifebinding Spirit (learned from My Buddy!).

Summon an Ethereal spirit companion (max 1) that moves when you do and is immune to harm. It can travel up to 4 spaces away from you. It lasts until you cast this spell again (the new spirit replaces it) or take a Safe Rest. You can use 1 Action to command it to do one of the following:

  • Harm | Reach: 4, Damage: 1d8+STR. Ignores armor. Damage type can be any from the schools you know.
  • Mend | (WIL/Safe Rest) Reach: 4. Restore WIL d20 HP to a Dying creature.

Bonus Commands. The spirit automatically gains one extra command for each of Protection, Divination, Nature, Shadow, Death, Blood, or Curse you know — Courage, Twist Fate, Wild Bloom, Cloaked, Reap, Share Vitality, and Misfortune respectively (full text on the companion). Each spends a Mend charge, like Mend.

Outside Combat. Your companion is a spirit, so it can pass through most obstacles. It can be up to 12 spaces away before teleporting back to you. Many places are aware of such spells and ward off such spirits.

Rushed Attacks and My Companion? You and your companion use the same action pool, but count as different creatures. So you can each attack once without the Rushed Attack penalty every round.

[A] Casting spawns the spirit token next to you — no mana; casting again replaces it; a Safe Rest dismisses it. Harm (1d8 + STR, +STR every 5 levels), Mend (WIL d20) and the bonus commands are on the token, baked with your STR/WIL/level when summoned; Twilight Sage doubles its dice. Mend and every bonus command spend 1 charge from the Mend counter granted by My Buddy! (with an Undo card), the same counter My Buddy!’s own Mend uses — correct it with the sheet’s +/-.

[M] Blue’s Codex features that count “the mana spent to summon it” or the spirit’s “unused ability uses/charges” (Spirits Ward, Contemplation of Purity, Reclaim Energy, Dazing Discharge) count your remaining Mend charges instead. Luminary of Storms / Trickery damage-type changes apply to Harm.
